title: AATIP, OAP and the UAP Task Force as red teams for the legacy program

tellings.quote: I think people well this gets into the fun with ATIP OAP UAP task force and the theory that a lot of that was red teaming the legacy program

plain: Several US government UFO studies from 2007 to 2021 may have been 'red teams' for an older secret program, playing the outsider to test how well that older program, which he calls the legacy program, kept itself hidden. That is the theory raised by Dylan Borland, a former Air Force intelligence specialist. The efforts he means are AATIP, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, a follow-on effort called OAP, and the UAP Task Force, a Pentagon group set up to look into unidentified aerial phenomena. He links this to the DIRDs, research papers on advanced and exotic technology that the Pentagon office commissioned, and calls it "the fun" with these programs. If true, the public studies were partly a test of how well the deeper secret held.
